sources.detail: All 6 registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 196-343 KB decompressed (sizes read off disk, not curl's size_download, which reports the compressed length under --compressed; r.jina.ai deliberately not attempted — IP-403 on this host). <style> stripped BEFORE parsing since the tier-list CSS ships inline, and <table class="tier-list"> asserted at EXACTLY 1 per page. Letter from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster (the first-alt rule is what excludes the spell-icon alts — verified on the raid tank page, where the S row's alts read Blood Death Knight / Death Grip Icon / Protection Paladin). Counts reconciled BEFORE any merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40 and M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, every letter inside the registered 7-band icyveins scale. ONE letter moved and it is on the raid TANK page: Protection Paladin A -> S. That page is the one that re-cut — its JSON-LD dateModified now reads 2026-08-29T15:00 where the stored published said 2026-08-08, and the deterministic pre-agent published-evidence artifact independently resolves it to 2026-08-29, so published was corrected to 2026-08-29 rather than carried forward (it has no in-body 'LAST UPDATED' line and its visible changelog still tops out at 08 Aug, which is why earlier runs recorded 08-08). All other published values re-read and unchanged: raid 08-30 / 09-01 / 08-29, M+ 08-30 / 08-30 / 08-30. Era: every page's body and changelog self-identify as Season 2 and Devourer is present in the DPS lists; the raid-healer page's title still reads (Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight) and is overridden by the body per the blue-tracker precedent. No seasonVerified value changed anywhere this run, so freeze-season had nothing to observe.

Both registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 160 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB decompressed. Parsed from tier__tier / tier__title / data-original-title and resolved by ROSTER MATCH, never by container position. The roster match is again what rejects the M+ page's second tierlist — its eight entries are the dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale) and none maps to a spec, which is exactly the 8 unmatched labels reported. Raid 40/40, M+ 40/40, 0 spec rows unmatched. ZERO letters moved. The pages' own 'Last Updated' lines are unchanged at 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (M+), which is the honest explanation for a static parse. Era-verified from the ranking bodies: both self-identify as Midnight and both list all three Demon Hunter specs including Devourer (raid A, M+ A), so no season question. Method carries no published field in the registry, so nothing to cross-check there.

All 6 registered pages fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 75-341 KB decompressed; r.jina.ai deliberately not attempted, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Recipe as recorded: unescape \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST, then find the [tier-list=rows] … [/tier-list] block (never anchor on WH.markup.printHtml — the raid-healer page carries a 1.2 KB decoy call), segment on [tier-label …]X[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace, and resolve each [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. Exactly one tier-list block per page; raid 27/7/6 = 40, M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 0 unmatched slugs, 0 duplicate-tier conflicts. ZERO letters moved, and every page's dateModified is unchanged from the stored published value — raid 08-31 x3, M+ 08-28 / 08-26 / 09-01 — which the deterministic published-evidence artifact independently confirms, so a static parse is exactly what a static page should produce. Era: all six bodies self-identify as Season 2 and the four DPS/tank pages carry Devourer; the Season 1 hits are changelog and retrospective prose, not the ranking body.

Not reachable — the archon.gg wall, night 11 (opened 2026-08-25/26). All 11 distinct registered archon.gg URLs fetched this run with the full browser header set: every one returned HTTP 403 carrying Cloudflare's "Just a moment..." interstitial (~6.0-6.2 KB, a challenge-platform script body) with __NEXT_DATA__ count 0 and zero "Human Verification" text. That is the OTHER shape of the same wall — the required-sources label records the 200-plus-human-verification-body form, so the assertion that mattered was made on __NEXT_DATA__ presence and not on the status code, exactly as that label instructs. No attempt was made to solve, replay or automate past the check, and nothing was backfilled from Warcraft Logs (Archon's letters are Archon's own tiering and its numbers its own percentile cuts — publishing ours under the archon source id would fabricate the source). Stored letters, numbers, encounter tiers and snapshot dates left byte-identical; the consensus stays Icy Veins + Method + Wowhead, "consensus of 3".

MERGED 23 rows from a genuinely fresh sim. MID2_Raid.txt HTTP 200, 1.36 MB, Last-Modified 2026-09-04T07:29:44Z, and it HAS a 'DPS Ranking:' block so the .html fallback was not needed. Era-verified off the report's own header build string rather than the visible version: 'SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69587 Live (hotfix 2026-09-02/69587, git build HEAD 7d86fb9c3a)' — the HEAD hash moved from the stored run's f5b50a3f97, which is the freshness detector and the honest explanation for values moving at all. 43 profile lines mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed (MID2_Demon_Hunter_Havoc_Fel-Scarred and MID2_Death_Knight_Frost_Rider both resolve), best hero-variant per spec, leading 'Raid' aggregate row skipped: 23 of 27 DPS specs, with the 7 unmapped lines being the tank profiles (Protection Warrior/Paladin, Brewmaster, Vengeance, both Blood builds) which are correctly excluded. Augmentation absent by design; Balance, Feral and Devastation still have no MID2 profile upstream, so the stored 23-row pool is unchanged in composition (no row drop). Moves are small and uniform — 23 of 23 rows moved, max 0.3%, family median 240106 -> 240089 — i.e. ordinary iteration noise, nowhere near maxValueMovePct 0.6. asOf 2026-09-04.

MERGED 40 rows. /period/latest HTTP 200, 204 KB, 302-resolving to period 1079 — the SAME weekly period as last night ('Period 1079, week 3 of MID2', Lindormi's Guidance / Xal'atath's Bargain: Devour / Fortified / Tyrannical / Xal'atath's Guile, top 2000 keys, 10000 characters, 3838 unique, 17.4 average key level) — but the window is rolling and the numbers moved: 31 of 40 values changed within the period. Parse bounded to the 'Spec representation in top keys' <figure> and read per <li> from the img alt plus the <span class="mt-1"> value, never a 'first percentage in the block' regex (the bar's height:NN% style precedes the value). Labels normalised on [-\s]+ so 'devourer demon-hunter' and 'unholy death-knight' resolve: 40 rows, 0 unmatched. Shape-checked BEFORE merging, which is the only thing that tells this column from the /meta per-key-presence one: the series sums to 100.2 and the role subtotals read Ranged 31.5 / Melee 28.5 / Tank 20 / Healer 20, i.e. the ~30/30/20/20 representation share. All values are below minValueMagnitude 100, so the relative-move guard correctly does not apply to a percentage that legitimately swings 0.3 -> 0.1. asOf 2026-09-04.
